dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$3.50 for ERP on my trip from Novena to Bukit Timah but I never asked for an expressway. I want the ERP line refunded.

chat_logs.content: Hello, I'm at Novena Square entrance.
Hi, you left a black umbrella in the back seat. What number can I call you on to arrange to return it? I can drop it at your block tomorrow.
Thanks so much! Please just leave it with the security guard at my block, no need to call.

app_events.details: ERP gantry crossed at Dunearn Road (Newton), S$3.50.
Trip completed; fare S$16.20 + ERP S$3.50 = S$19.70.

erp_pass_through.text: Governs ERP and toll charges. A true value means the actual ERP charge incurred on the trip is passed on to the rider and is shown on the receipt.

lost_item_return_contact_allowed.text: Governs a driver contacting a rider after a trip only to return an item the rider left in the car. A true value means such contact is allowed, through the app chat or by phone.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The receipt is S$16.20 base plus S$3.50 ERP = S$19.70, and the 19:30:00 gantry event shows the S$3.50 charge was really incurred at Dunearn Road. This trip's policy passes actual ERP through to the rider, so the charge is correct and nothing is refunded. The driver's 20:05:00 request for a number is only to return the rider's umbrella, which this trip's policy allows, and she answers it politely at 20:07:30; it is not a conduct issue.
